# Lonely Planet
> Expert travel guides, destination information, and trip-planning inspiration for travelers worldwide.

Lonely Planet helps travelers discover where to go, what to do, and how to plan trips with editorial destination guides, practical advice, itineraries, and inspiration. The site centers on destination coverage, themed travel ideas, and annual Best in Travel recommendations.

## Core
- [Home](https://www.lonelyplanet.com): Main entry point for travel inspiration, destination guides, and trip-planning content.
- [Search](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/search): Search Lonely Planet for destinations, articles, and travel inspiration.
- [Destinations](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/destinations): Browse destination guides by country, region, and city worldwide.
- [Best in Travel](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/best-in-travel): Annual collection of top destinations, journeys, and travel experiences.

## Best in Travel
- [Best in Travel](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/best-in-travel): Overview of Lonely Planet’s annual picks for top places and experiences.
- [Best in Travel 2026](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/best-in-travel): Featured recommendations for standout destinations and travel ideas for 2026.
- [Explore Best in Travel](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/best-in-travel): Curated editorial travel inspiration highlighting notable places to visit.
